title: Phishing Awareness
why: Phishing uses deceptive messages to influence users.
if_happens: Stop, report the message, and contact the appropriate security/help-desk channel.

title: Password Security
why: Password reuse allows one compromised credential to affect multiple services.
safe_practices: Use unique long passwords or passphrases
if_happens: Change affected credentials through the official service and review account activity.

title: MFA & Passkeys
why: MFA adds another authentication factor and passkeys can reduce phishing exposure.
if_happens: Deny unexpected prompts and contact support if the activity continues.

title: Social Engineering
why: Social engineering manipulates trust, urgency, or authority.
if_happens: Document the request and report it through the approved channel.

title: Safe Browsing
why: Unsafe browsing can expose users to scams, unwanted downloads, and credential theft.
if_happens: Close the page, avoid downloads, and report suspicious activity.

title: Secure Wi-Fi
why: Untrusted networks can increase privacy and interception risks.
safe_practices: Avoid sensitive activity on unknown networks
if_happens: Disconnect and use a trusted connection.

title: Software Updates
why: Updates often address known security weaknesses.
if_happens: Use the approved update process and seek IT assistance.

title: Ransomware Awareness
why: Ransomware can disrupt operations and create data-loss or extortion risk.
if_happens: Disconnect only according to approved incident procedures and contact security/IT.

title: USB & Removable Media Safety
why: Unknown removable media can introduce security risk.
if_happens: Stop using the device and report it.

title: Data Privacy
why: Sensitive information needs appropriate handling and access control.
if_happens: Notify the responsible team if data may have been exposed.

title: Mobile Security
why: Mobile accounts and devices contain valuable identity and data resources.
if_happens: Secure the device and report suspicious account/device activity.

title: Remote Work Security
why: Remote work expands the environments from which sensitive systems are accessed.
if_happens: Use approved support channels for suspected incidents.

title: Cloud Account Security
why: Cloud identities can provide access to many services.
if_happens: Report suspicious sessions and follow account recovery procedures.

title: Incident Reporting
why: Early reporting improves the ability to investigate and contain security events.
if_happens: Use the organization's security/help-desk reporting path.

title: AI-Enabled Scam Awareness
why: Generative AI can make impersonation and scam messages more convincing.
if_happens: Pause the transaction and report the suspected impersonation.
